steps: Purée chipotle peppers in adobo with a ladle of broth; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add fire-roasted tomatoes, broth, and smoked paprika; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in chipotle purée gradually until heat is balanced.
Add shredded chicken; warm through.
Finish with lime; serve with crema, tortilla strips, cilantro.
Sauté onion, garlic, and diced poblano.
Add tomato, broth, cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in black beans, hominy, and shredded chicken.
Simmer additional 5 minutes; finish with lime.
Garnish with queso fresco and tortilla strips.
Simmer tomatillo, onion, garlic, serrano in broth until soft.
Blend until smooth; return to pot.
Stir in cumin and shredded rotisserie chicken; warm through.
Top with avocado, cilantro, lime, tortilla strips, dried oregano.
Poach chicken breast in broth; shred when cool.
Sauté onion, garlic, bell pepper until softened.
Add tomatoes, corn, ancho, cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken and lime juice.
Garnish with avocado, cilantro, tortilla strips.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add cumin and chili powder; toast 30 seconds.
Stir in diced tomatoes, corn, zucchini, and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Add pinto beans; simmer 5 more minutes.
Finish with lime; serve with avocado, vegan sour cream, tortilla strips.
